kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. TLS is passthrough (mock) until enabled. Real TLS requires platform crypto (SChannel/OpenSSL) - future work.

cert_paths.comment: Filesystem paths to PEM/DER certificates. On Windows: C:\certs\aegis-ca.pem etc.

platform_behavior.linux: Mock TLS (passthrough, no encryption) - for host testing
platform_behavior.windows: Real TLS via SChannel or OpenSSL (future integration)
platform_behavior.comment: Same code compiles on both via builtin.os.tag guards
